characters.name: Gabi Diamond
characters.description: The feisty food blogger who ends up becoming a personal chef to tech tycoon Josh Kaminski. Belligerent Sexual Tension: Between her and Josh. Sofia actually calls them out on it during the season 4 finale "Young & Screwed".Sofia: Gabi, you're with him, you're without him, you love him, you hate him, you're over him, you'reunderhim! Betty and Veronica: Gabi is the Betty to Caroline's Veronica for Josh's Archie. An interesting twist is that Caroline is the wealthy, sophisticated brunette but she has known Josh longer than Gabi and he was already thinking of proposing to her when he met Gabi. Gabi is the poor, sweet blonde chef that had a one-night stand with Josh after he got dumped by Caroline.She basically sums up the situation in the pilot:Gabi: I'm like an Expired Twinkie, and the girl he loves is a fancy Chocolate Eclair. She basically sums up the situation in the pilot: Clingy Jealous Girl: Gabi gets very jealous whenever Josh expresses interest in another woman, especially in later seasons.

characters.name: Josh Kaminski
characters.description: Belligerent Sexual Tension: Gabi and Josh are very much attracted to each other but have a lot of issues in their relationship that's keeping them from becoming a steady couple. Benevolent Boss: Josh is this big time. He treats his employees like his friends and despite his ego, he truly cares about them and looks out for their well being.This gets him into trouble in "Young and Carless" when he trades in Gabi's broken down car for a newer used one with him paying the difference out of pocket. He ends up not realizing that Gabi's mother gave the car to her shortly before she died. He's even willing to pay up to $30,000 to fix his mistake but Gabi won't let him. He ends up not realizing that Gabi's mother gave the car to her shortly before she died. He's even willing to pay up to $30,000 to fix his mistake but Gabi won't let him. Betty and Veronica: He was the male Veronica to Cooper's Betty during most of season 2, constantly interfering in their relationship, and physically assaulting Cooper. Birds of a Feather: Josh and Gabi share so much in common that they'd make the perfect couple. The man is in love with another woman, unfortunately.

characters.name: Sofia Rodriguez
characters.description: All Take and No Give: One episode had her question why she is friends with Gabi, due to the latter's impulsiveness and obliviousness when she sold the couch her boss gave her for $800, even after promising not to. They make up in the end. Blatant Lies: Her family apparently thought she was still a virgin until Gabi blurted out the truth. Butt-Monkey: She tends to suffer a bit of this later seasons after losing her job at the bank. It takes her many episodes before she finds a part time job as a spin class instructors and later as the assistant to Logan Rollings and even then, she has it hard due to the crazy demands of her boss. Deadpan Snarker: Not to the extent of Elliot, but Sofia does have her snarky moments here and there. Enemy Mine: A variation of the trope happens between Caroline and Sofia quickly becoming friends. Even after it's revealed that Sofia was just faking being Cooper's girlfriend to keep his relationship with Gabi a secret, Caroline forgives her just because she was super devious about the fake dating. Caroline then visits Gabi and Sofia's rundown apartment which disgusts her and says nothing else to her as she leaves.

characters.name: Yolanda
characters.description: The Alcoholic: Later seasons imply that she might have a drinking problem. All Women Are Lustful: Since her divorce, she has been looking for a new beau and is often trying dating sites. Catchphrase: Oh my Damn! Intergenerational Friendship: She has this with Gabi, Josh and Sofia. Gossipy Hens: She may dislike Elliot but it doesn't stop her from gossiping with him and they practically compete on who gets the most gossips.

characters.name: Elliot Parks
characters.description: Asian Rudeness: It's mostly directed to Gabi and Yolanda, though. Camp Gay: He fits this to a T. He is extremely flamboyant, loves spa days and critical about fashion. Everyone Has Standards: Even he was disgusted with Josh for selling the car Gabi's late mother gave her. Freudian Excuse: It's hinted that he had a rough childhood, had a poor relationship with his parents and had to hide his sexuality during high school. It's implied that this is the reason why he is so jaded. Hilariously Abusive Childhood: He once asked his father for a bigger allowance, only to be yelled at and restricted for $0.50 until he was 18.

characters.name: Caroline Huntington
characters.description: Josh's girlfriend turned fiancé from season one. She is very materialistic and vain, caring more about her possessions and physical appearance than Josh. Alpha Bitch: he has a jerkish attitude that isn't Played for Laughs like Elliot and is quick to blame Gabi about anything shady that happens to her. Betty and Veronica: She is the Veronica to Gabi's Betty for Josh's Archie. Enemy Mine: Briefly had this with Sofia. Freudian Excuse: Josh reveals that her parents were rarely around when she was growing up and she had nannies change constantly, which may explain some of her issues.

characters.name: Cooper Finley
characters.description: A computer hacker who comes to work for Josh and becomes a love interest for Gabi. Amicable Exes: He and Gabi end their relationship on a high note as friends after Cooper gives her a genuine apology for his actions. Betty and Veronica: He was the male Betty to Josh's Veronica during most of season 2. Crazy Jealous Guy: He becomes very jealous after discovering the one-night stand between Josh and Gabi and Josh's own feelings for Gabi. Genius Slob: We only saw his apartment once and it was a bit of a mess.
